m: परि-√ मा Ā. -मिमीते (pf. -ममे; Pass. -मीयते; inf. -मातुम्), to measure round or about, mete out, fulfil, embrace, RV. &c. &c.; to measure, estimate, determine, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
परि-मा f. measure, periphery, MaitrS.
a: परिमा — {c2c} P., {c3c} {c4c} A. 1 To measure. --2 To measure off, limit --3 To estimate, determine. --4 To fulfil (a period or course).

samidikzudaRqAdizu ca hrasvatvavyavahAroBAktaH, BaktiScAtra prakarzaBAvABAvaH, Amasake yaH prakarzaBAvastasyABAvaH kuvale । viRve yaH prakarzaBAvastasyABAva Amalake, sa ca gORamuKyoBayaBAgitvAdBaktipadavAcyaH । dIrDahrasvatve nitye na varttete ityeke, parimARa eva te na Bavata ityapare, mahatsu dIrGamAnIyatAmitivat mahatsu varttulaM trikoRaYcAnIyatAmiti sUtraSezaH, tatra kAraRabahutvaM kevalaM tryaRuke mahattradIrTatve janayati mahattvapracacayostatkAraRe'BAvAt tacca bahutvamISvarApekzAbudDijanyaM tadbudDeranekavizayatve'pyadfzwaviSezopagraho niyAmakaH, evaM paramARudvayagataM dvitvaM dvyaRuke parimARotpAdakaM vakzyate dvAByAM tantuByAmapracitAByAmArabDe pawe kevalaM mahattvamevAsamavAyikAraRaM bahutvapracayayostatrABAvAt । yatra ca dvAByAM tUlakapiYjAByAM tUlakapiYjAraBastatra pariBARotkarzadarSanAt pracayaH kAraRaM bahutvasyABAvAt mahattvasya sattve'pi parimARotkarzaM pratyaprayojakatvAt । evaYca satiyadi mahattvaM tatra kAraRaM tadA na dozaH taduktaM “dvAByAmekena sarvErvA” iti । pracayaSca AramBakasaMyogaH, sa ca svAmimuKakiYcidavayavAsaMyuktatve sati svABisuKakiYcidavayavasaMyogalakzaRaH, sacAvayavasaMyogaH svAvayavapraSiTilasayogApekzaH parimARajanakaH “guRakarmmAramBe sApekza” iti vacanAt u॰ vf॰ । “ato viparItamaRu” ka॰ sU॰ “mahattvadIrGatve vyutpAdyARutvaM vyutpAdayati । ataH pravyakzasidDAnmahataH parimARAdyadviparItaM tadaRu parimA RamityarTaH । vEparItyaYcApratyakzatvAt kAraRavEparItyAcca, mahattve hi mahattvabahutvapracayAnAM kAraRatvam, etena dIrGatvabiyarItaM hrasvatvamityapi drazwanyam, vEparItyaYcAtrApi pUrvayat” u॰ vf॰ “idAnIM kuvalAsakAdAvaRutvavyavahAroBAkta iti darSayati । “aRu mahaditi tasmin viSezaBAvAt viSezABAbAcca” ka॰ sU॰ “itiSabdo vyavahAraparatAM darSayati, tena vilvApekzayA kuvalamaRu, kubalAgrekzayAmalakaM mahat, AmalakApekzayA vilvaM mahaditi tAvadvyAvahArI'sti, tatra mahaditi tezu vyavahAro muKyaH, kuta evamata Aha viSezaBAvAt mahattvaviSezasyEva taratamAdiBAvena BAvAt । aRuvyavahArastu tezu BAktaH, kuta evamata Aha viSezABAvAt aRutvaviSezasya tatrABAvAt, aRutyaM hi kAryyaM dvyaRukamAtravftti, nityaM paramARuvftti, kuvalAdO tadaBAvAt । yadvA viSezasya mahatvakAraRasyEvAvayavabahutvamahattvapracayAnAM kuvalAdyavayavezu BAvAt sadBAvAt । viSezABAvAt viSezasya aRutvakAraRasya mahattvAsamAnADikaraRadvitvasya kuvalAdyavayavezvaBAvAdasadBAvAdityarTaH” upa॰ vf॰ । “aRutvavyavahAro BAkta ityatra hetumAha । “ekakAlatvAt” kaRA॰ sU॰ “mahattvamaRutvaYca dvayamapyekaRin kAle'nuBUyate, te ca mahattvARutve parasparaviroDinI nEkatrASraye saha samBavataH, ato mahattvakAraRasadBAvAnmahattvapratyayastatra muKyI'RutvapratyayaprayogO ca BAktAvityarTaH” upa॰ vf॰ “mahattvapratyayasya muKyatve hetumAha “dfzwAntAcca” kaRA॰ sU॰ “dfSyate TA vastugatyA mahatsveva kuvalAmalakavilvezu sTUlasTUlatarasTUlatamavyavahAreRa BavitavyamityarTaH yaTA vastugatyA Suklezveva pawaSaNKasPawikAdizu SuklaSuklataraSuklatamavyavahAraH” upa॰ vf॰ । nanvaRu mahatparimARamitivyavahArabalAnmahattve'pi parimARe mahattvamaRutve'pyaRutvamastIti jYAyate tat kaTaM dravyamAtravfttitvamanayoH kaTaM vA guRe guRavfttitvaviroDA nApadyata ityata Aha । “aRutvamahattvayoraRutvamahattvABAvaH karmaguRErvyAKyAtaH” kaRA॰ sU॰ । “yaTA guRakarmaRI nARutvamahattvavatI taTA'Rutvamahattve api nARutvamahattvavatI ityarTaH prayogaSca BAkto drazwavyaH” upa॰ vf॰ । “nanu yaTA guRA guRavantaH kaTamanyaTA mahAn SabdaH dvO SabdO eccaH SabdaH catursiMSatirguRA ityAdivyavahAraH, karmARyapi ca karmavanti pratIyante kaTamanyaTA SIGraM gacCati drutaM gacCatIti vyavahAraH taTAcARutvamahattve api tadvanI syAtAmityata Aha । “karmaBiH karmARi guRESca guRA vyAKyAtAH” kaRA॰ sU॰ । “karmaBiH karmARi na tadbanti guRESca guRA na tadvantastaSrA'Rutvamahattve api na tadvatI vyavahArastu sarvatra BAkta ityarTaH” upa॰ vf॰ । nanu mahAnti karmARi aRUni karmARi mahAnto guRAH aRavo guRA ityAdivyavahArAdaRutvamahattvavanti karmARi tadumayavantaSca guRAH prasaktA ityata Aha । “aRutvamahattvAByAM karmaguRASca vyAKyAtAH” kaRA॰ sU॰ । “yaTA'Rutvamahattve nARutvamahattvavatI taTA na karmARi taduBayavanti na vA guRAstaduBayavanta ityarTaH, prayogastu pUrvavadBAkta iti BAvaH” upa॰ vf॰ । “aRutvamahattvaprakriyAM dIrGatvahrasvatvayoratidiSati । “etena dorGatvahrasvatve vyAKyAte” ka॰ sU॰ । “hrasvatvadIrTatve api na hrasvatvadIrGatvavatI mahottvotpAdakameva hrasvatvItpAdakam, kAraREkyAt kaTaM kAyeBeda iti cenna prAgaBAvaBedena pAkajavadupapatteH yatrEva mahattvaM tatra dIrGatvaM yatrARutvaM tatra hrasvatvaM yatra nityamaRutvaM tatra nityaM hrasvatvamityAdyatideSArTaH” upa॰ vf॰ । “idAnIM vinASakamAha “anitye'nityam” ka॰ sU॰ “etaccaturviDamapi parimARaM vinASini dravye varttamAnamASrayanASAdeva naSyati na tu viroDiguRAntarAt । Gawe satyapi tatparimARaM vinaSyati kaTamanyaTA kambuBaNge'pi sa evAyaM Gawa iti pratyaBijYeti cenna ASrayanASena tatra DawanASAvaSyakatvAt na hi paramARudvayasaMyoganASAd dvyaRuke nazwe tadASritasya trasareRIstadASritasya cUrRaSarkarAderavinASa iti yuktiraByupagamo vA, kaTaM tarhi pratyaBijYeti sEveyaM dIpakaliketi pratyaBijYAmavadBrAntitvAt । pradIpapratyaBijYA'pi pramEva hrasvatvadIrTatve paramutpAdavinASaSAlinI iti cenna tadvinASasyASrayavinASamantareRAnugrapatteruktatvAt” upa॰ vf॰ । “nitye nityam” kaRA॰ sU॰ । “tat kiM pArTivaparamARurUpAdivat paramARugatamaRutvaM SabdabudDyAdivadAkASAdigataM mahattvamapi naSyatItyata Aha । nityezvAkASAdizu paramARuzu ca yat parimARaM tannityaM vinASakABAvAt” upa॰ vf॰ । paramARuparimARasya vESezikasidDAM saMjYAmAha “nityaM parimaRqalam” kaRA॰ sU॰ parimaRqalameva parimARqalyam (svArTe zyaj) upa॰ vf॰ । “parimitivyavahArAsADAraRaM kAraRaM parimARamityarTaH” si॰ muktA॰ “aRu dIrTaM mahadDrasvamiti tadBeda IritaH । anitye tadanityaM syAnnitye nityamudAhftam । saMKyAtaH parimARAcca pracayAdapi jAyate । anityaM dvyaRukAdO tu saMKyAjanyamudAhftam । parimARaM GawAdO tu parimARajamucyate । pracayaH SiTilAKyo yaH saMyogastena janyate” BAzA॰ “taccaturviDam aRu mahad dIrGaM hrasvaYca । tatparimARam । nityamityatra parimARamityanuzajyate । jAyata ityatrApi parimARamityanuvarttate । anityamiti pUrveRAnvitam । taTA cAnityaM parimARaM saNKyAjanyaM parimARajanyaM pracayajanyaM cetyarTaH । tatra saNKyAjanyamudAharati । dvyaRukAdAviti । dvyaRukasya trasareRoSca parimARaM prati paramARuparimARaM dvyaRukAdiparimARaM vA na kAraRam parimARasya svasamAnajAtIyotkfzwaparimARajanakatvAt । dvyaRukAdiparimARantu paramARutvApekzayA notkfzwam । trasareRuparimARantu na sajAtIyam । ataH paramARO dvitvasaNKyA dvyaRukaparimARasya dvyaRuke, tritvasaNKyA ca trasareRuparimARa syAsamavAyikAraRamityarTaH । parimARajanyamudAharati । parimARaM GawAdAviti । parimARajaM kapAlAdiparimARajanyam । pracayajanyamudAhartuM pracayaM nirvakti pracaya iti” si॰ muktA॰ “parimARaM tUlakAdO nASastvASravanASataH” BAzA॰ “nASa iti arTAt parimARasya । na cAvayavanASaH kaTaM parimARanASakaH satyapyavayavini tricaturaparamARuviSleze tadupacaye cAvayavinaH pratyaBijYAne'pi parimARAntarasya pratyakzasidDatvAditi vAcyam paramARuviSleze dvyaRukasya nASo'vaSyamamyupeyastannASe ca trasareRunASaH evaM krameRa mahAvayavino nASasyAvakASatvAt sati ca nASake'naByupagamamAtreRa nASasyApavaditumaSakyatvAt । SarIrAdAvavayavApacaye'samavAyikAraRanASasyAvasyakatvAdavayavinASa AvaSyakaH । na ca padAvinASe'pi tattvantarasaMyogAt parimARADikyaM syAditi vAcyam tatrApi vemAdyamiGAtena samavAyikAraRatantusaMyoganASAt pawanASasyAvaSyakatvAt । kiYca tastvantarasya tatpawAvayavatve pUrvaM tatpada eva na syAt tattanturUpakAraRABAvAt tattantoravayavatvABAbe ca na tena parimARADikyaM saMyuktadravyAntaravat । taRAt tatra tantvantarasaMyoge sati pUrvapawanASastataH pawAntarotpattirityavaSyaM svIkAryyam । abayavinaH pratyaBijYAnantu sAjAtyena dIpakalikAdivat । na ca pUrvatantava eva tantvantarasahakArAt pUrvapawe satyeva pawAntaramAraBantAmiti vAcyam mUrttayoH samAnadeSatAviroDAt । ekadA nAnAdravyasya tavAnupalamBavADitatvAcca pUrvadravyasya pratibanDakasya vinASe dravyantArotpattirityavaSyamaByupeyatvAt” si॰ muktA॰ । vedAntimate aRumahadityeva parimARadvEbiDyam । tacca AramBavAdaSabde darSitam । evaM sAMKyamate'pi parimARadvEviDyam । “na parimARacAturviDyaM dvAByAM tadyogAt” sA॰ sU॰ ।

परि-√ मुच् P. -मुञ्चति (ind.p. -मुच्य; inf. -मोक्तुम्), to unloose, set free, liberate, deliver from (abl.), AV.; MBh. &c.; to let go, give up, part with (acc.), Kāv.; to discharge, emit, Kathās. : Pass. -मुच्यते (˚ति, MuṇḍUp.), to loosen or free one's self, get rid of (abl. gen. or instr.), RV. &c. &c.; to be liberated or emancipated (from the ties of the world), Kauś.; Up.
a: परिमुच् — {c6c} U. 1 To free, release, liberate; मेघोपरोधपरिमुक्तशशांकवक्त्रा Rs. 3. 7; Ch. P. 9. --2 To leave, quit, abandon. --3 To discharge, emit.

m: परि-मुग्ध &c. See परि-मुह्.
परि-मुग्ध mfn. bewitchingly lovely (-ता f.), Śiś.
a: परिमुग्ध — a. 1 Artlessly lovely, lovely yet simple. --2 Fascinating but foolish.

m: परि-मुग्ध—ता f.

परि-√ मुह् P. Ā. -मुह्यति, ˚ते, to be bewildered or perplexed, go astray, fail, ŚvetUp.; MBh.; R. : Caus. -मोहयति (˚ते, Pāṇ. i, 3, 89), to bewilder, perplex, entice, allure, trouble, disturb, Kauś.; MBh.; Kāv.
a: परिमुह् — {c4c} U. To be bewildered. or perplexed. --Caus. (Atm.) 1 To entice, beguile, allure; Bk. 8. 63. --2 (P.) To perplex.

m: परि-मुक्त mfn. released, liberated from (comp.)
परि-मुक्त—बन्धन mfn. released from bonds, unfettered, Śak.
परि-मुक्ति f. liberation, A.
a: परिमुक्ति — f. Liberation.

m: परि-√ मुष् P. -मुष्णाति, -मुषति (Pass. pr. p. -मुष्यत्, MBh.), to steal, plunder, rob a persons of (2 acc.), AV.; &c.
